thread:
anya: Quick recap from today's sync  we need a concise launch slate for private (VPC/on-prem) that customers can opt into without rearchitecting their network. Main asks: keep egress IPs stable, non-disruptive upgrades, and KMS/HSM options.
sam: Proposal summary: three lanes — "Installer-first" (minimal agent + preflight), "Anchored-egress" (operator that binds traffic to host source IP), "Relay-fallback" (stateless relay for NATed sites). Each lane has clear perf and rollback expectations.
mike: Technical note: preserving host source IP requires either hostNetwork daemonset or TPROXY/SNAT bypass. HostNetwork is simplest but has security concerns. TPROXY needs kernel modules and testing.
lina: Field: at least two customers will only accept host-source preservation, no app-layer proxies. They also require KMS integration (bring-your-own).
rahul: Risk callout: Relay adds latency and extra egress bandwidth. We need perf budgets and an easy opt-out. Also document support surface for mixed clusters.
jon: Acceptance criteria (must meet before GA):
- Upgrade success >=98% in automation harness
- Canary rollback median <=8 minutes
- Egress IP retained in >=90% host-network installs; relay documented with perf numbers
- KMS onboarding doc + sample configs for at least 2 vendors
sam: Preflight validator to include: outbound connectivity check, CA bundle presence, KMS handshake test, and a network topology probe. Example snippet:
```
# preflight-check
curl -sf https://status.redwood.local/ok || echo "connectivity-fail"
python3 -c 'import socket; print(socket.getfqdn())' || echo "dns-fail"
```
mike: Test matrix we must cover in staging: single-node airgapped, multi-node NATed VPC, peered DC with preserved egress, hybrid with on-prem relay. Automate in CI as much as possible.
lina: Suggested rollout gates:
- Beta: internal + 2 friendly customers, full telemetry on upgrade/rollback
- Small Canary: 5 customers with staggered windows
- GA: public docs, automated installer w/ preflight, runbook and 24x7 oncall window
rahul: Owners & deps: sam (operator + preflight), mike (egress tech & perf harness), lina (field pilot coordination), jon (docs + runbook). I'll take the validation script and test coordination.
anya: Timeline proposal: 1-week spike to prove host-source approach in lab; 2 sprints to build operator + preflight + docs; 2-week canary. Aim for initial customer canary before next quarter.
sam: Perf targets: relay P95 added latency <50ms, operator CPU overhead <3% on control plane hosts. Measure token throughput impact.
mike: Rollback playbook outline: immediate scale-down of new pods, reapply previous manifest, probe health endpoints until stable; if fails, escalate to manual rollback with cluster snapshot. Need runbook steps and RBAC checklist.
jon: I'll draft runbook and a short customer-facing FAQ (what changes, how to opt out, maintenance window expectations). Also will create a canary sign-up form.
anya: Final ask: product signoff on lanes, acceptance criteria, and owners by EOD Tuesday. @sam @mike @lina please ack.
sam: Ack, will start operator spike tomorrow.
mike: Ack, I'll prototype TPROXY fallback and perf harness.
lina: Ack, I'll surface two candidate customers for beta.
anya: Great  I'll collate these notes into the roadmap doc and add the canary sheet. Thanks all.
